Next came Nudimmud to her, butwith no better success. At length the gods decidedthat one of their number, called Merodach, shouldundertake the task of combating Tiawath theterrible. He was then given rule over the entire universe,and to test whether or not the greatest power hadpassed to him a garment was placed in the midstof the gods and Merodach spoke words commandingthat it should disappear.
